About

TraceSeis: Houston’s Specialists in Quantitative Reservoir Characterization

Founded in 2003, TraceSeis is a privately owned company that provides specialized geoscience solutions to the oil and gas industry from our offices in the Energy Capital of the World.

Our core expertise lies in characterizing the relationships between rock properties, reservoir attributes, and seismic data. We help clients reduce risk when quantifying reservoir properties by using well-calibrated seismic analysis.

 

Our Houston-based Geophysical Software for Quantitative Reservoir Characterization

We deliver value through three integrated offerings:

  • Services: Specialized geophysical and geological analysis
  • Consulting: Expert guidance on reservoir characterization
  • Software: Both proprietary technologies and commercial solutions

Our mission is to help energy companies make more informed decisions about subsurface resources through advanced seismic interpretation and analysis.
